question: In MS-PowerPoint, slide show options available to the presenter include all of the following, except for:
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Transitions command**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• In MS-PowerPoint, slide show options available to the presenter include all of the following, except for the **Transitions command**.
 
• **Slide transitions** are the animation effects that are applied to whole-slide when one by one next slide is displayed during a presentation.
